scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an algebraically closed field of prime characteristic p and a squarefree homogeneous binary form of degree p.
The local semigroups are standard invariants; the claimed contribution is their global distribution via the critical divisor for this family.
The characteristic-five example is verified computationally only for its finite arithmetic checks; the general theorem is proved in RESULT.md.
Independent audit has not been performed.
